# Initech kickoff meeting notes — 2026-02-10

Location: Initech Mexico City office, with Austin HQ on video · Tuesday, February 10, 2026, 10:00 a.m.–12:30 p.m. CT · Notes: Gonzalo Ríos (Acme Digital).

## Attendees

- Initech: Megan Holloway (VP of Marketing, Austin), Derek Lindqvist (Director of Demand Generation, Austin), Priya Raman (Marketing Operations Manager, Austin), Alejandra Cortés (Country Manager Mexico), Luis Garza (SDR Manager LATAM, Mexico City).
- Acme Digital: Andrés Villalobos (Account Lead), Natalia Aguirre (Paid Media Specialist), Gonzalo Ríos (Content & Webinars), Daniela Herrera (Data Analyst).

## 2026 Goals

- 6,000 leads, 2,350 MQLs and 560 SQLs from paid programs in the US and Mexico.
- $12.5M in marketing-sourced pipeline.
- Blended cost per lead at or below $75.
- Mexico should deliver at least 30% of all SQLs by Q4.
- The contract starts March 1, so March 2026 is the first full reporting month.

## Lead Definitions

- MQL: HubSpot lead score of 60 or higher, at a company with 200–2,000 employees in the US or Mexico.
- SQL: an MQL accepted by an SDR after a discovery call, logged in HubSpot within 5 business days of the hand-off.
- Students, job seekers and vendors are excluded from lead counts even if they fill out a form.

## Meeting Cadence

- Weekly sync: Tuesdays at 10:00 a.m. CT, 30 minutes, with Derek, Andrés and Natalia.
- Monthly performance review: second Thursday of each month, 45 minutes, with Megan.
- Quarterly business review: on video, except the January QBR, which is held in person in Austin.
- Day-to-day questions go to the shared Slack Connect channel #initech-acme.

## Tools & Access

- HubSpot Marketing Hub Enterprise: Initech owns the portal; Acme gets three Marketing Hub seats, granted by Priya Raman.
- LinkedIn Campaign Manager and Google Ads: Initech-owned ad accounts, with Acme added as account manager.
- Google Analytics 4: Editor access for Acme.
- Looker Studio: performance dashboard built and owned by Acme, shared with Initech.
- Figma: Initech brand kit, view-only for Acme.

## Approval Flow

1. Acme drafts ads, landing pages and emails in English and Spanish.
2. Derek Lindqvist reviews targeting and offers within 1 business day.
3. Megan Holloway signs off on anything brand-facing within 2 business days.
4. Spanish copy for Mexico is approved by Alejandra Cortés.
5. Any claim with a number in it (ROI, % of time saved, customer results) goes to Initech Legal, which needs 5 business days.

Budget shifts of more than 15% between channels need Derek's written OK.
